title: Preserve class-typed driver denials in durable fault records
description: HIGH-risk backend observability-only repair vs BASE 709f71a9e9ebb78adc3e813d0da3734364d7b3b3. A shared DriverDenial class and closed DRIVER_FAULT_LABELS module removes the driver/scheduler import cycle while preserving the driver public re-export. faultCode now recognizes only actual DriverDenial instances with allowlisted label and matching FAIL_CLOSED_<label> code prior to generic IntegrityError fallback. Non-driver IntegrityError and forged/unknown/tampered inputs remain generic; no raw error messages persisted. Existing PASS_FAULT, SETTLE_FAULT, skipped/tick results consume faultCode; recordDenial already saves e.label and quarantine sanitizes. Pure mapping/forgery tests and C04/C29 integration durable PASS_FAULT assertion added. No lease, heartbeat, retry, scheduler behavior or UI changes. Live demo repro is not available in this environment. npm verify:change and full suite have NOT run in this connector-only environment; hand off to local Devin for mandatory READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT and independent audit. No merge.
